text: This report recommends the appointment of one public member to the Toronto Preservation Board.

City Council on May 22 and 23, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint Peter Pantalone to the Toronto Preservation Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending February 9, 2028, and until a successor is appointed. 2. City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 and Confidential Attachment 2 to the report (May 1, 2024) from the City Clerk remain confidential as they relate to personal information about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Preservation Board. The balance of Confidential Attachment 1 and Confidential Attachment 2 to the report (May 1, 2024) from the City Clerk remain confidential in accordance with the provisions of the City of Toronto Act, 2006, as they relate to personal information about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Preservation Board.
